assumptions.statement: Official GIS/CAD boundaries, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire access and engineering constraints are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: All submitted land-use, building, road, public-space and phase layers are conceptual and cannot support statutory or construction decisions.

assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are repository-provided provisional geometries and are retained without manual relocation.
assumptions.impact: Area and ratio metrics describe the submitted provisional geometry only, not official planning extents.

assumptions.statement: No site survey, resident interview, worker interview, sensor observation or utility inspection was performed by the AI agent.
assumptions.impact: Problem statements are hypotheses derived from public sources and require human fieldwork before pilot selection.

assumptions.statement: CAPEX, OPEX, land availability, staffing levels and procurement routes are unknown.
assumptions.impact: The proposal uses sequence, owner, metric and stop-rule definitions instead of fabricated cost totals or delivery promises.

assumptions.statement: Pilot owners are proposed accountability roles, not confirmed commitments by any public agency, company or community.
assumptions.impact: Each pilot starts only after written owner acceptance, baseline review, privacy assessment and professional safety review.

assumptions.statement: Tsinghuayuan Station heritage controls are available as text but not as a verified coordinate polygon in this submission.
assumptions.impact: No heritage-control geometry is drawn; all nearby intervention remains a no-build holding condition pending authoritative coordinates.

assumptions.statement: The five regional relationships in the proposal are conceptual interfaces and proposed collaborations, not signed partnerships or official coordination mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: Each interface requires written consent, a named owner, lawful data/venue permissions, entry checks and an explicit exit path before any pilot or public claim.

assumptions.statement: The three honor/failure displays and replaceable public-space components are reference designs for professional deepening; maintenance roles are proposed only.
assumptions.impact: No component is treated as an approved construction, procurement, landmark, or operating commitment until ownership, heritage, fire, accessibility and lifecycle checks pass.

assumptions.statement: Dazhongsi intelligent-native consumption and business conversion depends on verified title, heritage/land-use, traffic, fire, accessibility, utilities, operator, cost and footfall information that is absent from this package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal supplies a reversible concept sequence and prerequisites only; it makes no tenancy, revenue, investment, visitor or implementation claim.
